subject: Renewal paperwork: term shift and order-form consolidation for Veridian expansion
messages:
From: Nate Ruiz <nate.ruiz@veridian.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: natalie.rojas@veridian.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + expansion - MSA + order form redlines

Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're looking to move forward with the renewal and expand committed capacity across three models (chat-general, embeddings-search, reranker). A few high level asks from our side so legal can start: 

- Term: we'd like to shift to an 18-month renewal (instead of 12) and lock pricing for the term.
- Capacity: bump committed units from 2M tokens/month to 2.5M (20% uplift) with burst to 5M.
- Data residency: all production inference must be served from EU region nodes.
- Auditability: we need an Exhibit for audit logs (retention 3 years) and a KMS clause confirming customer-managed keys.
- SLA: increase credit cap for availability credits to 12% for sustained incidents >1h (we can discuss triggers).

I've attached our initial redlines as a Word doc — please have counsel review and let us know the parts Redwood is unlikely to accept so we can prioritize. Also include any immediate pricing delta for the 18-month term + capacity uplift.

Attachments: Veridian_Requested_Redlines.docx (tracked changes)

Thanks,
Nate
---
Nate Ruiz
Head of Platform Partnerships
Veridian AI
nate.ruiz@veridian.ai
+44 20 5555 9012
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthis>
To: Nate Ruiz <nate.ruiz@veridian.ai>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion - MSA + order form redlines

Nate — appreciate the detailed ask and the redlines. We'll route to Legal and Procurement; copying Laura and Ben to lead the paperwork and commercials. Quick initial notes from our side: 

- Term: 18 months is doable but we typically require a minimum firm commit for billing. We can propose 18 months with a mid-term true-up (6-month cadence) to ensure usage aligns with committed tiers.
- Capacity/pricing: rough back-of-envelope uplift is ~+9% on run-rate for the committed increase (net of burst pricing). Ben will pull precise numbers and update the order form.
- Data residency & KMS: we support EU-only serving on Private/Dedicated; for hosted with EU nodes we'll need to confirm KMS integration details with Security.
- SLA credits: we can discuss raising the cap, legal will want to limit exposure w/ outage definitions.

I'll attach the latest order form draft with a few placeholder fields. Laura — can you take point on the MSA redlines and call out fatal vs negotiable items (indemnity, KMS language, audit clause, termination for convenience)?

Next steps: Laura to confirm redline stance, Ben to upload an updated draft order form and pricing, and I'll align with the customer on DocuSign timing once we have an agreed packet.

Attachments: draft_orderform_v3.pdf

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
karithik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal + expansion - MSA + order form redlines

Forwarding Veridian's ask and Nate's redlines. I've started a tracked-change pass and flagged the following for negotiation with the customer/legal: 

1) KMS / Data Residency: the proposed wording expects customer-managed keys across hosted and dedicated. We can agree to KMS for Dedicated and Private, but for hosted we can provide tenant-isolated keys managed by Redwood with strict export controls. If the customer insists on full CMK for hosted, we need SOW and a separate service add-on.

2) Audit logs Exhibit: we can add Exhibit D with a 3-year retention, but need to define format and access method. Recommend limiting forensic export frequency to two 30-day exports per year to manage operational load.

3) SLA credit cap: customer wording unlimiteds the credit ceiling. Propose cap at 12% but with a rolling annual cap (not per incident). Also need clear definitions for sustained incidents (>1 hour continuous degraded availability).

4) Termination for convenience: customer requests ability to terminate after 90 days. We should counter with a 6-month notice for termination for convenience during the firm commit, and pro-rate any prepaid credits.

5) Indemnity / Liability: their redline removes our liability cap. We should keep the mutual carve-outs for gross negligence and IP indemnity; propose a commercial liability cap tied to 12 months' run-rate.

I'll attach the MSA redline doc for review. Ben — please make sure the order form reflects the tiered pricing for the 18-month term and the proposed run-rate uplift.

Attachments: MSA_redline_trackchanges.docx

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Natalie Rojas <natalie.rojas@veridian.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Nate Ruiz <nate.ruiz@veridian.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 16:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + expansion - MSA + order form redlines - updated redlines and signature

Karthik / Laura — thanks for the fast turnaround. We've reviewed Redwood's counters and made a few concessions to move this forward: 

- Agreed: limit hosted KMS ask to an add-on; Veridian will accept Redwood-managed tenant keys for hosted if a KMS SOW is triggered when CMK is required.
- Agreed: audit log Exhibit D with 3-year retention; please confirm the export cadence (we're ok with 2 exports/year).
- SLA: we'll accept the rolling annual cap at 12% as discussed.
- Term: we'll convert to 18 months but would like a 90-day exit window post first renewal anniversary for business reasons.
- Liability: final ask is to carve back the cap for IP indemnity only — otherwise maintain mutual cap at 12 months' run-rate.

I've attached our updated redlines (clean + signed near-final). When you're ready, the DocuSign envelope is prepared here: https://www.docusign.com/verify?token=ABCD1234VERIDIAN

Attachments: Veridian_Redlines_signed.pdf

Looking forward to closing this week — Nate will coordinate procurement.

Best,
Natalie Rojas
Legal Operations
Veridian AI
natalie.rojas@veridian.ai
